title: Governed phase delivery
purpose: Move each implementation phase from isolated branch to accepted main without bypassing executable evidence.
entry_condition: A phase branch exists from the current accepted main baseline.

transitions.action: complete minimum scoped implementation and tests
all required GitHub Actions checks pass

invariants: No merge transition is legal while a required check is failing or missing.
The next phase starts from revalidated main.
failure_behavior: A failed check keeps the phase unaccepted and requires repair on the phase branch.
restart_behavior: Rerun only after a source/spec/test repair or a justified transient-run retry.
rollback_behavior: A defective merged phase must be reverted through a new governed change and revalidated.
